issues.message: alert() "Your trial ends in 3 days" opened the browser's native dialog, called at /dialog-before.html:4:51. Replace it with the app's own toast or snackbar ("Saved"), or with an inline message next to the field for a form error. Use the toast/dialog component the project already has (search for one: sonner, react-hot-toast, a components/ui/dialog, MatDialog / MatSnackBar, ElMessageBox…) before adding a library.
